book.name: MATEO
book.title: JA' WATX' K'ANE TZ'IBEBIL CAN YU NAJ MATEO

content: Eb Jix Seyon Tzet Utbil Jix Yute Smitx'on Jesús
Ja' yet jix lawi yalon Jesús wan ti' tet eb ánima, jix yalon jaxca ti' tet eb scuywom:
—Je yotaj xa, tol caabe xa c'al chi oc cu pascua. Jain Ak'bil Wopiso yu Dios xol eb ket animail ti', ja' ton yet tu' oj jin ale oc yul sk'ab eb oj jin aon oc yin te' culus, ẍi Jesús tet eb.

Ja' eb yaawil yak'omal xaambal eb Israel tet Dios, yetoj eb cuywam yin sley Moisés, c'al eb yicham winajil conob, jix syamba sba eb bey jun miman sna naj Caifás, naj sat yaawil yak'omal xaambal eb Israel tet Dios.
Jix slatine el eb tzet lek'ti'al oj yaoc eb yiban Jesús, tzet utbil oj chi mi'cha naj yu eb, catu' chi yak'on cam naj eb.
Jix yalon eb jaxca ti': —Ma ske' cu mitx'on yet k'in ti', yutol ey smey, oj tit sjowal eb ánima kin yu, ẍi eb.
Jun Ambal Suk'uk'i Sab Jix Sec'le Atoj Yiban Sjolom Jesús
Jix apni Jesús bey conob Betania. Jix apni bey sna naj Simón, naj ya' ey yet peyxa yu jun ya'bil chi yij lepra.
Chotan ey Jesús slowi, catu' jix apni jun ix ix sc'atan. Jix yi'tej jun ch'en net alabastro ix.
Nonaj ch'en yetoj jun ambal suk'uk'i sab caw ey stool. Jix sec'on atoj ix yin sjolom Jesús.
Jix yilon jun tu' eb scuywom, catu' jix tit sjowal eb yin ix. Catu' jix yalon eb jaxca ti': —¿Tzet yuxan na'ba c'al chi etex el jun ti'?
Ja' jun ambal suk'uk'i sab ti', caw ey stool. Yel watx' chi txonle el oj, catu' chi po'letoj stool xol eb meba', ẍi eb.
Ja' yet jix yaben Jesús jun tu', jix yalon tet eb jaxca ti': —¿Tzet yuxan pena che yal yin ix? Ja' jun jix yun ix e in ti' an, caw watx'.
Ja' eb meba' che yal tu', ey c'al ec' eb je yetoj. Pero jainti', c'am jin c'al ec' je yetoj.
Yin ey oj to jix yaon oc jun suk'uk'i sab ti' ix yin jin mimanil, yet watx' listo xa we an, yet chin mujle an.
Caw yel chi wal e ex, yal c'al tzet lugaril bey yul yiban k'inal ti', bey oj al-le el sk'aneal yet colbanile, oj al-le pax el sk'aneal tzet jix yun ix ix ti', catu' oj na'letej ix, ẍi Jesús tet eb.
Jix Yak' Sti' Naj Judas, Yaon Oc Jesús Yul Sk'ab Eb Ac'ul
Ja' naj chi yij Judas Iscariote, naj ey oc tz'ajil oj eb lacawan scuywom Jesús, jix bet k'anab yetoj eb yaawil yak'omal xaambal eb Israel tet Dios.
Jix yalon naj tet eb jaxca ti': —Ta chi waoc Jesús yul je k'ab, ¿jantaj chin je tolane? ẍi naj tet eb. Jix yak'on treinta tumin plata eb tet naj.
Yuxan, ja' yet jun c'u tu', jix ẍa' xa c'al el yich seyon tzet utbil oj yute yaon oc Jesús yul sk'ab eb.
Ja' Scena Naj Kaawil

Ja' yet babel sc'ual jun k'in yet chi lo'le ixim pan c'am yich, jix oc joyan eb cuywom yin Jesús, catu' jix sk'anlen eb tet naj jaxca ti': —¿Beytu' cha woche chi cu wa'ne bey oj cu lowoj, yu cu na'ontej k'in pascua ti'? ẍi eb tet Jesús.

—Asi' bey conob. Chex to bey sna jun winaj. Che yalon tet jaxca ti': “Chi yal cu cuywam, tol nianxane tiempoal ey jin ec' oj. Yuxan ja' bey ja na ti' oj jin low yetoj jin cuywom ti', yu cu na'ontej k'in pascua,” quey tu' che yute je yalon tet naj, ẍi Jesús tet eb.
Yuxan, jix to eb cuywom tu' jaxca jix yun yal-le tet eb tu' yu naj. Jix swa'nen tzet oj slo' eb yet pascua tu'.
Yet jix k'ejbi ey xin, jix ey chotan Jesús low yetoj eb scuywom tu'.
Ja' yet lalan slow yetoj eb, jix yalon jaxca ti': —Caw yel chi wal e ex, Ja' cu xol ti' ey jun oj jin aon oc yul sk'ab camich, ẍi Jesús tet eb.
Caw jix cus a sc'ul eb yet jix yaben eb jun tu'. Yuxan jun jun eb jix sk'anle yab eb tet: —Wuẍtaj, ¿man mi jain oj wun jun tu'? ẍi eb yin jun junal tet Jesús.
Yuxan jix yal Jesús tet eb jaxca ti': —Ja' jun mac junne ey sk'ab wetoj yul plato ey ey cu nan ti', ja' ton jun tu' oj jin aon oc yul sk'ab camich.

Jainti', Ak'bil Wopiso yu Dios xol eb ket animail ti', pero sowalil oj jin cam oj, jaxca tz'ibebil can yul An Juun Tz'ibebil can oj. Pero ok'bal c'ule jun oj jin aon oc yul sk'ab camich tu'. Yel watx' yet jun winaj tu' ta ma aloj, ẍi Jesús tet eb.
Ja' naj Judas, naj jix aon oc naj yul sk'ab camich tu', jix yalon naj jaxca ti': —Jaach cuywam, ¿man mi jain oj cha wal tu'? ẍi naj tet Jesús. —Jaach toni, ẍi Jesús tet naj.

Ja' yet lalan slow Jesús yetoj eb scuywom tu', catu' jix yi'on a ixim pan. Jix yalon yu diosal tet Dios yu ixim. Catu' jix spo'on ec' xol eb tu'. Catu' jix yalon tet eb: —Low wej. Jin mimanil jun ti', ẍi Jesús tet eb.
Catu' jix yi'on a jun vaso. Jix yalon yu diosalil tet Dios yu tzet ey yul jun vaso tu'. Catu' jix yak'on tet eb. —Uc' wej jun ti' je masanil.
Yutol jin chiq'uil jun ti'. Yu jin chiq'uil ti', yuxan oj yun jun ac' strato Dios.
Oj el jin chiq'uil ti' yet watx' ec'al mac oj lawoj can spenail yu.
Chi wal can e ex tinani', c'am xa bey oj wuc' yal sat an uva ti', masanta' c'al yet jun c'ual oj wuc' junel xa je yetoj titu'. Yet oj oc xa c'al cu Mam yin Yaawil, ẍi Jesús tet eb.
Jix Yal Jesús Yin Ey Oj To, Tol Oj Yi' El Jesús Naj Pedro Yin
Jix sbit'nen eb jun bit' chi sbit'ne ta' eb tet Dios,
catu' jix to eb bey wonan Olivo.

Jix yalon Jesús tet eb titu' jaxca ti': —Ja' yet jun ak'bal ti', oj caablaboj a je c'ul win je masanil an. Quey tu' yalon can yul An Juun Tz'ibebil can oj, bey chi yal jaxca ti': “Oj wak' cam naj ilom me'. Ja' no' me' tu', oj sajlem can toj no'” ẍi yul An Juun tu'.
Pero ja' yet oj jin pitzc'u pax a oj, oj jin baboj to je sattaj bey Galilea, ẍi Jesús tet eb.
Catu' jix yalon naj Pedro tet Jesús jaxca ti': —Cax c'al oj caablaboj a sc'ul masanil eb ja win, pero jainti', c'am bak'in oj caablaboj a jin c'ul, ẍi naj Pedro tu' tet Jesús.
—Caw yel chi wal e ach, ja' yet jun ak'bal ti', oxel xax jin ja wi' el ja win an, catu' oj ok' a no' caẍlan. Oj ja waloni tol man jin ja wotaj an, ẍi Jesús tet naj Pedro.
—Cax c'al oj jin cam ja wetoj, pero tutun ma jaach wi' el win an, ẍi naj Pedro tu' tet Jesús. Ja'c'ala' yalon masanil eb cuywom.
Jix Bet Jesús Txaloj Bey Getsemaní
Jix lawi jun tu' xin, catu' jix to Jesús yetoj eb scuywom bey jun lugar chi yij Getsemaní. Jix yalon tet eb titu' jaxca ti': —Eyan nej can chotan titi'. To jin txaloj cu sattaj ti', ẍi Jesús tet eb.
Jix yi'on sbey naj Pedro yetoj, c'al eb cawan sc'aal naj Zebedeo. Catu' jix c'oli scus a sc'ul, c'al yoc yin tac c'ulal.
Jix yalon Jesús tet eb: —Ian chin cam yu cus c'ulal chi wab an. Canan nej titi'. Iquis ojab jex wetoj an, ẍi Jesús tet eb.

Catu' jix jitzontoj sba nioj xa. Jix ey kaan oj, catu' jix ey xa c'al noan sat tx'otx'. Catu' jix txali jaxca ti': —Mamin, ta chi ske' cha na', manchej jul jun sya'ilal tu' wiban an. Pero man jaxca oj chi woche jainti' an, pero jaxca ojab cha woche jaachti', ẍi Jesús yin xa.
Jix lawi tu' xin, jix jul junel xa bey jix can can eb oxwan tu', catu' jix yiloni, lalan swey eb. Yuxan jix yal tet naj Pedro: —¿Tumi c'am chi ske' je tec'ba je ba tet weyan junoj hora wetoj an?
I' wej el je weyan. Txalan nej, yet watx' c'am chex ey q'ueyi, yet ey mac chi yak'le jex yijban yin spenail. Ja' cu pixan, tec'an ton yei, pero ja' cu mimanil, c'am chi techa yu, ẍi Jesús tet eb.
Catu' jix to naj junel xa txaloj. Jix yalon yin xa jaxca ti': —Mamin, ta c'am chi ske' tol c'am chi jul jun sya'ilal ti' wiban an, ske' ojab jaxca cha woche, ẍi Jesús yin xa.
Catu' jix jul junel xa sc'atan eb oxwan tu', jix yiloni tol chi wey a eb, yutol caw c'am chi techa weyan yu eb.
Jix can eb yu naj junel xa. Jix to txaloj yet yoxelal. Jaxca c'al jix yute txaloj sba yet sbabelal, quey tu' jix yute txaloj sba.

Jix jul junel xa sc'atan eb scuywom tu' xin, jix yalon tet eb jaxca ti': —¿Tumi ja'c'ala' je weyi? ¿Tumi comon xewilal che yune'? Ja' tinani', jix a apnoj yorail wale oc yul sk'ab eb penawom, jain Ak'bil Wopiso yu Dios xol eb ket animail ti'.
Aan nej waan oj, toon nej. Ilala, chi jul naj oj jin aon oc yul sk'ab eb, ẍi Jesús.
Smitx'banil Jesús

Lalan to yaloni, catu' jix apni naj Judas, naj yet cuywomal sba yetoj eb naj jusluc'wan tu'. Ec'al ánima ey ec' yetoj naj. Ey eb i'bil oc espada, ey eb i'bil oc ste'. Chejbiltej eb yu eb yaawil yak'omal xaambal eb Israel tet Dios, c'al yu eb icham winaj ey yopiso xol eb Israel tu'.
Ja' naj Judas tu', naj lalan yaon oc Jesús yul sk'ab eb, jix yal tet eb tzet oj yute x'oxon oc oj, jix yal tet eb jaxca ti': —Ja' jun oj jin tz'ub el sti', ja' ton jun tu' che mitx'a, ẍi naj tet eb.
Yuxan, jix sjitztoj sba sc'atan Jesús yin eymanil. Jix yalon tet naj jaxca ti': —Buenas noches, Jaach Cuywam, ẍi naj Judas tet Jesús.
Catu' jix oc tz'uban yin sti' naj Jesús.
—Jaach wamigo, ¿tzet chi jul ja wune? ẍi Jesús tet naj. Catu' jix oc eb yin naj Jesús yin eymanil. Jix smitx'on naj eb. C'anani jix yute eb.
Pero ey jun ey ec' yetoj Jesús, jix tzac' atej yespada yin eymanil. Jix tzoc'on el xiquin jun smoso naj yaawil yak'omal xaambal eb tet Dios.
Catu' jix yalon Jesús tet naj jaxca ti': —Ak' meltzo ey ja wespada tu' yul s'umal. Yutol ja' mac chi yak'balne espada yin jowal, yetoj espada oj yun scami.
¿Tumi man ja wotaj oj, ta chi woche chin k'ana, ey ec'ban sesenta mil ángel bey cu Mam Dios, tol chi jul colwa win yin eymanil?
Pero k'inaloj ta chin k'ana, ma el oc jaxca yalon can yul An Juun Tz'ibebil can oj, tol sowalil jaxca ti' oj ec' el wiban an, ẍi Jesús tet naj.

Jix lawi tu' xin, catu' jix yalon tet eb jix apni pax tu': —¿Tumi elk'om jin che yila, yuxan i'bil oc je yespada c'al je te', chin jul je mitx'oni? Jun jun c'al c'u chotan jin ey jin cuywa je nan je xol bey yul stemplo Dios, pero ma jin je mitx' pax titu'.
Jaxca ton ti' chi yun xin, yu yunen el tzet tz'ib ye can yu eb ẍejab Dios yul An Juun Tz'ibebil can oj, ẍi Jesús tet eb. Jix bejle can Jesús yu eb cuywom xojli. Jix el eb smasanil.
Jix I'letoj Jesús Sattaj Eb Sat Yaaw
Ja' eb jix mitx'on Jesús tu', jix yi'toj naj eb sattaj Caifás, naj yaawil yak'omal xaambal eb tet Dios. Ja' ta' titu' jix syamba sba eb cuywam yin sley Moisés, c'al eb icham winaj ey yopiso.
Ja' naj Pedro, naat tzajan c'al chi yute sba naj, masanta' c'al jix apni bey jun miman sna naj sat yaawil eb tu'. Jix ey chotan yetoj eb policía, yet watx' chi yila, tzet c'al oj jul oj.
Ja' eb yaawil yak'omal xaambal eb tet Dios tu', yetoj eb icham winaj c'al masanil eb sat yaaw, jix sey wan testigo eb jix sna'on a k'ane eb yin Jesús tu', tzet utbil oj yun scami.
Ec'al eb jix oc testigoal tu', jix sna'on a k'ane eb yin Jesús tu'. Pero c'am junoj jix oc yopiso tzet jix yala. Tzunan xa jix apni cawan xa lek'ti' testigo.
Jix yalon eb jaxca ti': —Jaonti', jix kab yalon jun winaj ti' jaxca ti': “Jainti', chi ske' wuchon ey stemplo Dios, pero ja' yet yox c'ual tu' chi a pax sq'uexel wu an,” ẍi naj, jix kabe, ẍi eb.
Ja' naj yaawil yak'omal xaambal eb tet Dios, jix a linan naj, jix yalon tet Jesús jaxca ti': —¿Tumi c'am chach tak'wi nioj? ¿Tumi c'am cha wab wan chi yal eb ti' ja win? ẍi naj tet Jesús.

Pero ja' naj Jesús, c'am c'al tzet jix yala. Yuxan, jix yal tet naj junel xa jaxca ti': —Al e on, ta Cristo jaach, ta Sc'aal jaach Dios. Sowalil cha wal sattaj Dios iquis, ta yel cha wala, ẍi eb tet Jesús.

—Jain ton ti' jaxca ja walon tu'. Chi wal pax e ex, ja' jain Ak'bil Wopiso yu Dios xol eb ket animail ti', oj jin je yil yet chotan jin ey bey swatx' k'ab Dios, naj Miman Yipal. Oj je yil pax weyol satcan xol asun, ẍi Jesús tet eb.
Ja' yet jix yaben wan tu' naj yaaw tu', jix snic'ontoj nioj spichil naj,
catu' jix yalon naj tet eb yet yaawilal jaxca ti': —Ja' jun winaj ti', buchwal chi yun yin Dios. ¿Tzet to wal chi oc testigo ku tinani', yutol jaon caw jix kabe tol chi buchwa yin Dios?
¿Tzet ẍi je c'ul yin naj tinani' xin? ẍi naj yaaw tu'. —Pena chi el yunen naj, smoo chi cami, ẍi eb.
Jix c'oli tzuble oc eb yin sat. Jix smak'on naj eb. Ey eb jix smak'ontoj sti' naj.
Catu' jix yalon eb tet Jesús jaxca ti': —Jaach Cristo, na' el oj mac jix jaach mak'oni, ẍi eb tet Jesús.
Ja' Yet Jix I'on El Jesús Naj Pedro Yin
Ja' naj Pedro tu', chotan ec' bey sti' jun miman na tu'. Jix apni jun ix criada sc'atan, jix yalon ix jaxca ti': —Jaachti', ja wetbi ja ba yetoj Jesús a Galilea, ẍi ix tet naj.
—Man wotaj oj jun cha wal e in tu' an, ẍi naj sattaj masanil eb, catu' jix yi'on el sba naj yin.
Lalan xa wal yeltoj bey spuertail tu', catu' jix yilon jun xa ix, jix yalon ix tet eb yaman ec' oj: —Ja' ton jun winaj ti', yetbi sba yetoj naj Jesús a Nazaret, ẍi ix.
Jix yi'on el sba naj Pedro yin junel xa. —Ch'il Dios caw man wotaj oj jun winaj tu', ẍi naj Pedro tet eb.
Yet jun xa txolan catu' jix yalon eb ey ec' titu' tet naj Pedro jaxca ti': —Caw yel ja wetbi ja ba yetoj eb scuywom Jesús, yutol laan ja k'anab yetoj eb chi kabe, ẍi eb tet naj.
Catu' jix c'oli sk'anontej sjowal sc'ul Dios naj yiban. —Chi yil Dios tol ja' jun winaj tu', caw man wotaj oj an, ẍi naj Pedro tet eb. Ja' yet jix lawi yalon jun tu', catu' jix ok' a no' caẍlan.

Jix sna'ontej naj tzet jix yal Jesús tet, yet jix yalon jaxca ti': “Oxel xax jin ja wi'on el ja win, catu' oj ok' a no' caẍlan, yet oj ja waloni tol ma jin ja wotaj oj,” ẍi Jesús tet naj. Yuxan, jix eltoj naj Pedro sti' na tu', catu' jix mi'chcha sc'ul naj yok' sic'lebil.

footnotes.text: Ja' ch'en alabastro, ja' ton jun ch'en watx' yili, c'uun pax oj. Chi k'anbalnele ch'en yet chi wa'xi snetal xumac te' c'al wan limeta watx' yili.
Ja' yet chi x'oxon el eb, tol yel oj yun jun trato, chi yi' el ẍiq'uil no' nok' eb. Éxodo 24:8.
Ja' jun bit' chi bit'nele yet k'in pascua, tejan ja' Salmos 115; 118.
Jix yal naj Judas: “Col ja ba, jaach cuywam.” Ja' jun tu', jun saludo jaxca chi kal jaonti': “Buenas noches.”
Jix yal Jesús: “Laoneb Legión eb ángel.” Ja' jun Legión, jun bulan soldado. Ey wajeb mil soldado yin jun Legión.
Jix snic'toj spichil eb yet chi yoche chi x'oxon sya'ilal eb ma scus c'ulal eb. Jaxca ti' jix yute sba eb, yutol jix yab eb buchwal k'ane yin Dios, yala.
